items.title: Amgen (AMGN) Wins Backing In Europe For Broader Repatha Use
items.summary: Amgen (NasdaqGS:AMGN) received a positive opinion from the European Medicines Agency’s CHMP for an expanded Repatha indication in Europe. The recommendation covers use of Repatha to help reduce cardiovascular risk in high risk adults without a prior heart attack or stroke. The CHMP view is based on Phase 3 clinical data that showed a significant reduction in major adverse cardiovascular events. Amgen is a large biotech company with a focus on cardiometabolic, oncology and immunology...
